name: chip
title: Chip
description: The one labelled pill primitive — 10 decorative hues, two tiers, an optional selection rung, and a real 24x24 remove control. Behind Tag and FilterChip; ComboboxChip is Base UI's own chip, not this primitive.

meta.whenToUse: A labelled, optionally removable pill — a record label, an applied filter, a selected value in a multi-select.
meta.whenNotToUse: A status signal (Badge) or a clickable action (Button); a Chip's root is not interactive.
